name: Lineup
description: Lineup is an application that fetches Electronic Program Guide (EPG) data from a HDHomeRun network TV tuner and converts it into XMLTV format — the standard format used by media servers like Jellyfin and Plex for TV guide display. It includes a web-based dashboard, a terminal UI, live TV streaming with transcoding, and automatic scheduled EPG fetching with smart incremental updates.
